title: Page 176
transc:
Gen Butlers Hd Qrs May 30 1864
Maj Eckert Di
private minnie harsh poney zodiac I here
heavy & continuous firing about ghost miles
from here in direction of battery patent
it may be Jupiter has reached there
R OBrien


Hd Qrs Genl Butler May 30
Maj Eckert Di  7.30 PM
snake Martha laugh for indigo unity I learn from
a reliable deserter from the rose that Holcomb legion
consisting of perfume or pension prolong spit has gone
to brandy & that Colquits pelican is to follow
on behind them zebra they were sent in pursuance
of a wrangle received by Holland on saturday saying
that by the time Holland received the dispatch secession
ville would be in the hands of the none
zodiac this the deserter heard from pandora Gilliard of
the harrow postpone Avon walrus Knave some ravishness now
R OBrien
